bibl.title: Callimachus' Victoria Berenices: A Case Study in Elegiac Epyllion.
bibl.seg: Aaron Palmore, Callimachus' Victoria Berenices: A Case Study in Elegiac Epyllion.
bibl.note: Using Callimachus' Victoria Berenices as a case study, argues that elegiac poems have a place in the conclusions and investigations of epyllion.
